messages:
tim-sales: Heads-up — Monarch Health submitted a security questionnaire (CAIQ + a 6-page custom appendix). They want answers and a network diagram by EOD Friday. POC contact is laura@monarchhealth.com. Any volunteers to own intake and coordinate with ENG for BYOK/network? :hourglass:
raj-security: I can own the intake. Need the deployment topology, KMS approach, and whether this POC uses Dedicated or Hosted. @maria-eng can you drop the latest infra diagram? Also, do we have a recent SOC2/pen test PDF to attach?
maria-eng: I have the network diagram for the private deploy variant. Will attach in a sec. It's the VPC + private GW flow we used for Acme last quarter.
sam-se: FYI POC note — customer said "may require HSM-backed keys" in the questionnaire. If true, pricing for Dedicated + BYOK/HSM changes. @amy-sales can you confirm budget / prefers BYOK?
amy-sales: Confirmed: customer prefers BYOK/HSM if it's doable. Budget is in the mid-enterprise range but needs a pricing snapshot before next Tues. I'll send contact on cost constraints to the thread.
sec-bot: New intake ticket created: SR-5234. CAIQ template attached, status=unclaimed.
raj-security: Assigned SR-5234 to myself. Plan: 1) Fill CAIQ answers where we have standard responses, 2) flag any questions that need ENG input (network, HSM), 3) prepare a short risk note for sales. ETA: first draft tomorrow AM.
maria-eng: Attached diagram: `monarch-private-vpc-2026-03.png` (shared link: https://s3.internal/diagrams/monarch-private-vpc-2026-03.png). Notes: there is an optional NAT path and a dedicated peering option — call out if they expect inbound connections.
raj-security: Quick ask — in the CAIQ they ask "key lifecycle & rotation". Our standard line is: "keys are customer-managed when BYOK; we support KMS integrations with rotation policies configurable by customer." Use that in answers and I'll add technical footnote.
sam-se: Pricing impact: Dedicated + HSM = add recurring node surcharge + one-time HSM setup fee. I can run numbers if Amy confirms Dedicated required.
amy-sales: Laura confirmed they'd prefer Dedicated for the POC. I'll mark that in the ticket and share the email thread.
raj-security: Great. @maria-eng please confirm if the HSM integration requires network changes (e.g., dedicated peering). If yes, give an estimate.
maria-eng: It does for external HSMs — we recommend peered VPC or private link. Estimate: 3-5 days setup + infra config for a POC.
amy-sales: Noted. Laura also asked for turnaround on evidence: SOC2 + pen-test. I attached our SOC2 summary PDF to SR-5234 and a link to the pentest high-level (redacted).
raj-security: I'll populate CAIQ with those attachments and tag any answers that are partial. Will ping ENG in-line for clarifications. Leaving a short checklist here:
```
- fill CAIQ standard responses
- attach SOC2 & pentest
- request HSM network plan from ENG
- provide pricing delta for Dedicated+HSM
- produce risk summary for sales
```
amy-sales: Thanks — that's perfect. I'll loop in procurement contact and schedule a call with Monarch for Thurs AM.
sec-bot: SR-5234 status updated: in-progress (owner=raj-security, priority=high).
